current_f2_source_fact.fact: VoiceOutputPacket stores text_segment, planned_audio_duration_ms, playback_state, heard_fraction and interruption_ms. Interrupted output may retain a monotone heard_fraction, but the packet contains no playout-synchronized transcript prefix, token/audio alignment, word timing map or sink receipt that deterministically maps a scalar heard_fraction back to the exact words actually heard.

causal_problem.statement: Even after product authority selects RETAIN_HEARD_PREFIX_EPHEMERALLY_ONLY, heard_fraction alone is insufficient evidence for the exact next-turn text prefix.
counterexample_family: Two outputs can both report heard_fraction=0.5 while the first half of audio contains different numbers of spoken words because of pauses, prosody, speaking-rate variation or non-speech lead-in.
A generated text midpoint is not generally an acoustic-time midpoint.
A planned_audio_duration_ms estimate is not proof of actual sink playout duration.
Generation completion time is not proof of what reached the listener when output buffering or delayed playback exists.
causal_problem.failure_if_ignored: The system can retain unheard words or forget heard words while still presenting a numerically plausible heard_fraction; either case corrupts causal next-turn dialogue context.

external_primary_reference.finding: PlaybackFinishedEvent exposes playbackPosition and an optional synchronizedTranscript that may be partial when interrupted, explicitly separating playback progress from transcript synchronization.
Audio sinks report playback_position, interrupted state and optionally synchronized_transcript; PlaybackProgressedEvent represents audio stretches that actually played and can no longer be discarded.
Realtime interruption handling keeps history aligned with what the user actually heard and recommends RealtimePlaybackTracker when playback can be delayed.
RealtimePlaybackTracker tracks current item/content identity plus elapsed_ms of actually played audio rather than inferring heard state from generated duration.

research_conclusion.policy_dependency: PREFIX_RETENTION_POLICY_UNRESOLVED remains the semantic authority gate; this delta does not self-select policy.
research_conclusion.evidence_requirement_if_retain_policy_se: A playout-synchronized heard-prefix evidence object or equivalent must bind exact output identity to actual sink progress and the transcript prefix admitted into next-turn ephemeral context.
research_conclusion.fail_closed_rule: If the sink can prove elapsed audio but cannot map it to a synchronized transcript prefix, preserve the measured acoustic boundary as evidence but do not invent an exact textual heard prefix from heard_fraction alone. The next-turn context decision remains UNKNOWN/POLICY-EVIDENCE-INCOMPLETE for exact-prefix semantics.
research_conclusion.authority_boundary: This evidence object must not become a second canonical memory/effect authority; it is causal playout evidence feeding the existing voice/context integration boundary.

impact_on_existing_hf09.oracle_refinement: HF09 should not accept heard_fraction-only reconstruction as proof of exact prefix retention. Its receipt should bind actual playout timing and a synchronized prefix or explicit alignment evidence before classifying PREFIX_AMNESIA_PRODUCT_NEGATIVE versus semantic match.
impact_on_existing_hf09.tail_leak_rule: Any text proven to lie beyond the synchronized heard boundary but present in next-turn effective context remains TAIL_LEAK_PRODUCT_NEGATIVE once the retain-prefix policy is explicitly admitted.
impact_on_existing_hf09.prefix_amnesia_rule: A proven synchronized heard prefix absent from next-turn effective context becomes PREFIX_AMNESIA_PRODUCT_NEGATIVE only after the retain-prefix policy is explicitly admitted.

next_exact_action: Do not dispatch another runtime job. First obtain explicit product/owner selection of the interrupted-response next-turn context policy. If RETAIN_HEARD_PREFIX_EPHEMERALLY_ONLY is admitted, Trigger4 should bind the existing HF09/HF10 runtime lane to playout-synchronized prefix evidence rather than heard_fraction-only inference, then execute the existing discriminator and promote only the measured causal context scope. In parallel, WP716 may continue independently; do not use the media-lab claim to bypass this semantic/evidence gate.
